# Sanctioned skips for the rust_test job in .github/workflows/sami-rust-test.yml:
# tests the fork's owner ruled out of the gate. The job
# passes each to every test binary as `--skip <name>`, and fails unless each
# name matches exactly one test, in the named target, which then did not run.
# A skip that is not here fails the job like any other (the known-skip list
# and the parity check). Add a line only with the ruling: who made it, when,
# and its words.
# One per line: <bazel test target> <libtest test path>  <ruling>.
